## Design decisions

- **Detector-driven, ticket-scoped.** Both detectors were already
  structurally green; the worklist was the ticket's named docs plus the
  G4-flagged stale statements (G4-4/G4-6 honoured as recorded — the
  prefix flip itself is explicitly a round-3 chore, not this ticket).
- **Modes honoured.** Historical/append-only records were not rewritten:
  DEFERRALS untouched; LEDGER/BUILD_INDEX gain lines only at closeout;
  OPERATIONAL_READINESS is the living capability account (rewritten each
  reconcile) so the stale gate line was corrected in place.
- **No ADRs** — no owned decision, no MET-DIFFERENTLY verdict (the
  DOC.1 precedent).
- **No new claims.** Nothing above `fixture-verified` is asserted; the
  env/human rows stay named and gate-pending.
